disposition_reason: The source contains an ordered four-tone MEG decoding task in Methods Pipeline 1, Figure 1c replication and Supplementary Figure 1, so source-native rebinding is possible. Exact published accuracy matrices, full participant/fold identities and publication-to-code parity remain unrecovered. The descriptive null conclusion remains calibration: stronger null evidence or larger prestimulus accuracy cannot by itself establish neural pre-activation or a method improvement.

source_paper.title: No evidence of neural feature-specific pre-activation during the prediction of an upcoming stimulus

evidence.locator: Methods: Data analysis and Pipeline 1; Figure 1c replication and Supplementary Figure 1; Pipelines 2-3 and Discussion
evidence.supports: Original participant-specific four-tone LDA decoding, percent-correct time-generalization task, original entropy conditions/folds and retained empirical/theoretical controls; scientific null inference is distinct from ordered decoder accuracy.

target.description: Classify the four actually presented tones from individual-participant MEG at the original train/test time samples: train on random sequences and test all four entropy conditions under source Pipeline 1. Preserve the full temporal-generalization accuracy panel and sound/omission analyses separately; inferential pre-activation claims are distinct from decoder-performance gains.

dataset.description: The 2026 reanalysis reuses Demarchi2019 MEG release DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3268713, not a new recording cohort.

cohort.description: Author sound code requires four conditions for every mapped participant. The registration specifies 33 participants/132 recordings, but publication-vintage participant inclusion and the full manifest join were not independently authenticated here.

split.description: Paper describes stratified five-fold classification trained on random-block sounds, with testing across entropies. Pinned sound code instead uses KFold(5), 0-0.32 s training and -0.666-0.666 s testing; historical producer/version parity remains unresolved.

inputs.description: Original participant MEG sensor samples at each source time point, with known sound labels and entropy/block identities used to construct original train/test support. Test labels, transition probabilities and confusion matrices may construct the retained source controls but cannot become extra features for the neural decoder.

preprocessing.description: Paper specifies provided 100 Hz, 1-30 Hz data; pinned sound code additionally filters 0.1-30 Hz and removes selected trigger events plus successors. Exact publication execution must be pinned for reconstruction.

metric.description: Tone accuracy is correct predictions divided by tested trials at each train/test time. Scientific assessment compares original and null maps and entropy correlations; 0.25 alone is not a valid prestimulus null.

aggregation.description: Author code averages folds within participants and R consumes participant time-generalization matrices. Exact published accuracy arrays, participant/time/entropy reductions and a complete-panel improvement decision remain unrecovered. Do not collapse to a favorable time cell, select only one entropy or treat time cells as independent subjects.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Pipeline 1 percentage of correctly decoded tones across the full source participant/time/entropy panel

published_baseline.description: Original source decoder performance is shown in Figure 1c replication and Supplementary Figure 1, but exact numeric accuracy matrices and their complete source aggregation have not been recovered. The nominal25% chance level, null contrasts and Bayes evidence are not the author decoder baseline.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Pinned reproduce_and_reorder_sound.py identifies the LDA route, but original participant/fold support and stratified-paper versus KFold-source differences prevent claiming historical parity. No authentic matched author decoder rerun is established.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a useful accuracy gain after recovering the complete published decoder panel and baseline variability; do not optimize entropy-confounded prestimulus cells or use a smaller null-test p-value as the effect.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired participant-level candidate-minus-author inference with original trial-order, repeated folds and temporal/entropy dependence preserved; specify multiplicity and a full-panel decision before evaluation.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Participant; repeated trials, folds, entropy conditions and temporal cells are dependent observations.
uncertainty.rationale: The original group inference establishes controls for interpreting temporal decoding, not an automatic superiority criterion. Source null controls remain mandatory for any anticipatory neural-information interpretation.

paper_win_requires: Recover exact original Pipeline1 published decoder accuracy matrices, full participant/trial/fold support, source timing and all four entropy conditions, including the original sound/omission distinctions.
Reproduce the publication-aligned participant-specific LDA baseline and resolve stratified-fold, filtering and time-window discrepancies before candidate comparison.
Freeze candidate, original inputs and preprocessing, meaningful effect, full-panel aggregation/multiplicity, participant-level uncertainty and matched budgets before final evaluation.

Surpass the source decoder on identical original support under that declared rule. New splits, easier input conditions, a favorable time/entropy subset or a corrected_methods_v1 profile are extensions, not historical same-task victories.

Retain empirical reordered-sequence and theoretical confusion/transition controls. Higher prestimulus accuracy alone does not establish anticipatory neural information, and stronger evidence for the paper's null conclusion is not decoder improvement.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison has been verified; reproducing this finding establishes neither a paper win nor SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Blocked pending original decoder source recovery. Then iterate using declared source training/development feedback only; preserve participant-specific random-sequence training and original entropy generalization, with all attempts logged.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze classifier, preprocessing, original participant/trial/fold manifests, temporal/entropy score panel, complete decision rule and budgets before original test evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Compare candidate with authenticated original LDA on the complete source Pipeline1 support and accuracy panel; report uncertainty and preserve the source empirical/theoretical controls. Descriptive null inference remains a separate scientific interpretation.
episode.baseline_policy: Published decoder accuracy, an authenticated author rerun, and local corrected-method profiles remain distinct. Reconstruction of the null finding is calibration; nominal chance and authored analytical controls cannot substitute for the source decoder.

blocking_issues: Exact original decoder accuracy matrices and full-panel numerical aggregation are unrecovered.
Publication versus pinned code differ in cross-validation, filtering and temporal support; original execution parity must be recovered rather than silently corrected.
Complete participant/file/trial joins and original fold assignments remain unauthenticated.
Meaningful accuracy effect, participant-aware uncertainty, full-panel multiplicity, concrete access/resources and a working same-task evaluator are unspecified.

legacy.notes: Retain full temporal-generalization matrices, empirical/theoretical nulls, group inference and historical source reconciliation as calibration. The current contract may bind only the original ordered Pipeline1 decoder; corrected_methods_v1, new splits and sensitivity/power studies remain extensions, and null-claim agreement is not a victory.
